entities.summary: Council of Trent & Counter-Reformation, a transformative movement in Holy See (1534–1648). Emerged from Michelangelo completes the Sistine Chapel ceiling and Protestant Reformation. Catalyzed Council of Trent opens – cornerstone of the Counter-Reformation and Pope Pius VI dies a prisoner of France at Valence.
